# Awaaz Labs

> Awaaz Labs is the AI front desk for appointment-based businesses. It answers every inbound call, WhatsApp, SMS, email and web form 24/7 in the customer's language, qualifies the lead, books the appointment, sends reminders, recovers no-shows, reactivates lapsed customers and collects reviews. Every conversation is transcribed and scored by Qualicall. A product of Finova Solutions.

Key facts:
- Category: AI receptionist / missed call recovery / appointment booking automation
- Deployed in production on three continents: United States (Sirius Solutions Global), United Arab Emirates (Advanzatech, 70 meetings booked in month two), Pakistan (Telecom Foundation, Government of Pakistan Ministry of IT subsidiary)
- Live in 2 to 3 weeks from signed agreement
- Languages: Arabic (including Khaleeji, Levantine and Egyptian dialects), English, Hindi, Urdu, with mid-conversation switching
- Security: in-region data residency, HIPAA-architected, ISO 27001 aligned, end-to-end encrypted, full audit trail
